features.name: Android migration nullability annotations
features.scope: RecentlyNonNull and RecentlyNullable retain platform types under pinned default WARN enhancement. Nullable arguments, explicit nonnull result checks, nongeneric reference fields, ordinary generic calls, strict-marker precedence and generic field rejection boundaries are checked.
restrictions: Warning diagnostics are not reproduced. Custom per-annotation enhancement settings are unsupported.
Global JSR-305 strict/ignore options do not override these annotations in the pinned reference; both are verified independently.
Nested generic type-use paths remain outside this feature.

androidbible.remaining_boundary: A typed diagnostic copy exposes INNER_TYPE nullability on ResourcesCompat.getDrawable Resources.Theme parameter; the unchanged source remains unresolved during delegated-property inference.

limitations: No Android runtime or full-app compatibility claim. The source archive is the exact tested compiler tree, based on the recorded revision plus this feature.
